outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (breast anatomy diagram) plus a table of classification frequencies; it is not a plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating circadian phenotype categories and study aims; no data plot is present.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental setup for luciferase recordings; no quantitative plot is shown.
Panel D shows line plots (time-series traces of circadian signals for models #1-3); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt since individual points are not meaningful in this context.
Panel F contains a line plot of cell number over days for different models; line plots are exempt from needing overlaid individual points.
Panel G shows dose-response line/curve plots of growth inhibition; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel H displays gene expression and mutation heatmaps across cell lines; heatmaps are exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel I shows PCA and 3D scatter plots where each dot already represents an individual data point (individual cell line/model), satisfying the requirement inherently.
